itens.title: Full-Stack Developer / Logistics Integrations Engineer
itens.description:
Building and evolving systems for high-volume logistics operations with a strong focus on reliability, integrations, and automation — aligned with challenges large marketplaces tackle at scale (throughput, operational consistency, and resilience to partner/API failures).
  • Microservices and integrations with carriers, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms, emphasizing clear contracts, safe retries, and fewer inconsistencies across distributed workflows.
  • Event-driven architecture with messaging and asynchronous processing to decouple domains and absorb traffic spikes without degrading critical operational paths.
  • End-to-end traceability, observability (metrics, correlated logs), and practices that shorten mean time to diagnose and recover from operational incidents.
  • Optimization of hot paths—latency-sensitive queries and integrations, strategic use of caching and queues for predictable I/O cost.
  • Distributed environments with Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ; continuous backend evolution with availability, maintainability, and safer production rollout in mind.
  • Automations and guardrails that reduce manual rework, repetitive errors, and silent failures in third-party integrations.

itens.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / AI Solutions Engineer
itens.description:
Responsible for designing and integrating intelligent full-stack systems for national and international medical societies using Node.js, Vue.js, and cloud services.
  • Developed a medical e-learning platform (Vue.js/Vuex) with detailed tracking and engagement analytics, increasing course completion rates.
  • Created the World Kidney Day platform, connecting hospitals nationwide for health awareness campaigns.
  • Developed a geolocation-based specialist search tool, ensuring accurate and localized results for users.
  • Implemented an annual fee and recurring subscription management system integrated with Mercado Pago, significantly reducing delinquency rates.
  • Currently applying AI integrations and automations to optimize workflows and improve system scalability.
All projects delivered measurable improvements in efficiency, usability, and maintainability.
